description: The qodo-cli bridge (qodo-cli serve), reached on the loopback of the machine it runs on: http.call runs where this actor lives, so machine is the bridge's machine. The findings flow calls POST /verbs/findings/list (role viewer), the improvement flow POST /verbs/config/propose (role editor) and the fix flow POST /verbs/fix/propose (role editor), so the service token needs the editor role: issue it on the bridge's machine with qodo-cli tokens issue --name <name> --role editor (printed once), store it in grant as QODO_BRIDGE_SERVICE_TOKEN and inject it into the engine node's unit. Replace the base URL in the workflows if the bridge listens elsewhere, and keep allow to exactly that address.
name: qodo-cli bridge
